label: Custom
notes: Custom is the catch-all for every business type that is NOT an office (see commercial.json): Dental Clinic, Hospital, Restaurant, Pub, Retail Store, Showroom, Temple, Lighthouse, and anything else. The user names their own subcategory and rooms as free text instead of picking from a fixed list. Empty roomTypes/walkthroughOrder mean 'no predefined list, no preferred order' rather than 'none allowed'; the frontend falls back to free-text room entry and walkthrough order defaults to the room list's own order.
